document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You have failed! Depending where you are, your experiences 
vary. Coastline lines suffer dramatic flooding and panic ensues. 
Scientists claim the Earth has somehow shifted on its axis and 
that terrible consequences will follow. Indeed, they do. Storms 
of primeval force sweep the continents. Melting polar ice fuels 
the flooding, while terrifying ice storms strike at the heart of 
civilization. Once it begins, much of the world of humankind is 
destroyed within days. 
The City of the Old Ones has a new master, and the whole 
world pays for your failure. Your revolver has a bullet in the 
chamber. Whether you choose to use it or not, it is ... THE END.
(100, 173, 315, 525, 529, 530, 541, 542, 566, 567)
